APEC: Forum of 21 Pacific Rim economies that sets non-binding trade and investment goals.
ASEAN: Ten Southeast Asian states cooperating on trade, economy and security.
CBP: The US agency that clears goods entering the United States and collects duties.
DDP: The seller pays duties and taxes upfront: the customer pays nothing at delivery.
DDU: Duties and taxes are collected from the customer at delivery, often with a handling charge.
EU: 27 countries with a single market and a customs union.
IOSS: EU scheme letting sellers collect import VAT at checkout on consignments up to €150 and declare it monthly in one country.
IPC: Cooperative association of postal operators that publishes cross-border e-commerce research.
SKU: A unique reference for one product variant, used to track stock and price.
UPU: UN agency that sets the rules for international mail exchanges between postal operators.
USMCA: The North American free trade agreement that replaced NAFTA in 2020.
VAT: Consumption tax charged at each stage of the supply chain and paid in the end by the consumer.
WCO: Intergovernmental body that maintains the Harmonized System used to classify goods.
WTO: Global body that sets and arbitrates the rules of trade between nations.
